# Writing Shape Skill for Muse

Give Muse your raw material and it shapes it into an article paragraph by paragraph: it first drafts two or three candidate openings with different angles, you pick (or blend) one, then the piece grows block by block, with Muse arguing out loud whether each block should be prose, a list, a table, or a quote. Every transition has to earn its place, and weak paragraphs get cut without mercy. Discovered via skills.sh. Beta note: this skill lives in the author's experimental in-progress folder, so treat it as a promising beta. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
